cell.label: Hypoxemia and chest radiograph with new or worsening bilateral alveolar infiltrates consistent with pulmonary edema. Measure BNP.
Likely ARDS. No further diagnostic studies necessary.
Indeterminate. Further studies will be required to differentiate ARDS from cardiogenic pulmonary edema (CPE).
Transthoracic echocardiogram with either of the following: systolic ejection fraction <45% without valvular abnormality, or significant aortic or mitral valve disease?
Clear temporal relationship to ARDS risk factor (eg, sepsis, aspiration)?
Likely cardiogenic pulmonary edema (CPE). No further diagnostic tests necessary.
Likely cardiogenic pulmonary edema (CPE). No further diagnostic tests necessary.

footnotes.footnote: Abbreviations: ARDS, acute respiratory distress syndrome; BNP, brain natriuretic peptide; CPE, cardiogenic pulmonary edema; PAC, pulmonary artery catheter; PAOP, pulmonary artery occlusion pressure.
